operations.title: Operations dashboard
operations.description: Quick links to CloudWatch / Budgets / Alarms on AWS. Use these to monitor the platform after deployment.
operations.no_dashboard_dev_alert: CloudWatch Dashboard name is not configured in runtime-config. This is a dev or undeployed environment.
operations.dashboard_body: The CloudWatch Dashboard provisioned by ObservabilityStack. Shows deploy chain / DDB / Lambda / API Gateway metrics on one screen.
operations.budget_body: AWS Budgets monthly threshold alerts and Cost Explorer for detailed analysis. SystemAdmin receives email at 80% / 100%.
operations.cost_unavailable: Live budget data is unavailable (no monthly budget is wired for this environment). Use the links below.
operations.alarms_body: CloudWatch Alarms (Lambda invocations / Errors, DDB throttling, API Gateway 5XX). Detects Free Tier breach and backend incidents.

login.description: Sign in as a system administrator. You will be redirected to the Cognito Hosted UI.
login.title: TenkaCloud System Admin Console
login.subtitle: Sign in with your platform administrator account.
login.error_body: We could not start the sign-in flow.
login.saml_pick_idp: Multiple identity providers are connected for this domain. Pick one to continue.

tenant_list.empty_body: Create your first tenant to invite an admin and deploy problems.
tenant_list.col_problem_deploys_explain: Per-tenant aggregate of problem CFn stacks on competitor AWS accounts. Blue = in-progress, red = failed (CFn CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE error). Click a tenant to drill into individual deployments.
tenant_list.open_console_aria: Open {tenantName}'s Application Admin Console in a new tab
tenant_list.logs_codebuild_aria: Open {tenantName}'s provisioning build in the AWS Console
tenant_list.deprovision_modal_body: Deprovisioning {tenantName} ({tenantId}). Its CloudFormation stack and DynamoDB records will be removed.

tenant_create.name_description: Display name of the organisation hosting the competition (recorded as the tenant isolation unit)
tenant_create.email_description: Address that receives the Cognito invitation as the admin of this tenant
tenant_create.tier_platinum: Platinum — dedicated (Silo: dedicated Cognito / Application Console)

jobs_page.description: Recent 50 executions of tenkacloud-saas-pipeline. Refreshes every 60 seconds.
jobs_page.not_configured_body: The admin-insight API URL is not set in runtime-config. Complete Phase 2 deploy.
jobs_page.forbidden_body: Only members of the SystemAdmin group can view this. Please sign in again.
jobs_page.empty: No pipeline executions yet — you may not have created a tenant.
jobs_page.deprovisioning_phase1_header: Deprovisioning Jobs API is not wired
jobs_page.deprovisioning_phase1_body: The admin-insight Lambda has not received the deprovisioning state machine ARN. Run the latest 'make deploy' (= Issue #814 Phase 2).
jobs_page.deprovisioning_open_console: Open Step Functions in AWS Console
jobs_page.deprovisioning_open_console_aria: Open AWS Step Functions console (state machine list) in a new tab
jobs_page.empty_deprovisioning: No deprovisioning executions yet. Triggering a tenant deletion will record entries here.

tenant_detail.missing_id: Tenant ID is not specified in the URL
tenant_detail.not_found: Tenant {tenantId} was not found. It may have been deleted.

audit_log.title: Audit log
audit_log.description: Trail of SystemAdmin / TenantAdmin operations. Newest first, polled every 60s.
audit_log.empty_hint: Operations (tenant create / delete / IAM changes etc.) appear here when executed.
audit_log.not_wired_body: Because config.adminInsightApiUrl is empty, the audit log cannot be loaded. Complete Phase 2 deploy and inject adminInsightApiUrl into runtime-config.json.
